title: Chapter 191: Ants Kill Elephants
content:
Chapter 191: Ants Kill Elephants

By observing Xu Wen's movements when releasing his skills, he found that although Xu Wen's arm movements were different when he released his skills, his fingers formed the same shape.

Moreover, the body will become temporarily stiff and sounds will come out of the mouth.

These actions all appear a few tenths of a second before the skill is released.

If you can interfere with these movements of his, you may be able to interrupt his skills.

Wang Shuo thought of this and silently communicated his thoughts with Ayub, Gong Zheng and Gu Liji.

Guliji's golden dagger - Kiss of the Fangs. The attack can have a paralysis effect. At the same time, combined with the "backstab" skill, it can be activated instantly. It is the best choice to interrupt the enemy's spellcasting.

At the same time, Wang Shuo also took out the soil and made a temporary mud puppet. It has a taunting skill and can also interrupt spell casting.

However, the sludge puppet's health is too low. Once it gets close, it can easily be killed instantly. You must master the timing of your attack.

After another ten minutes, Xu Wen's defensive buff disappeared again.

When Wang Shuo saw that his fingers were forming seals, he immediately shouted: "This is the time."

The mud puppet immediately stepped forward and started taunting.

Gu Liji also flashed behind Xu Wen and launched an attack.

His current defense is only 100 points, and almost everyone's attacks can cause effective damage.

Suddenly, Xu Wen's body trembled slightly after being attacked, which lasted for 1 second.

It was this short 1 second that finally interrupted his spell casting.

In this way, as long as it is within his skill CD, he will no longer be able to use "Righteousness".

As for "three people becoming a tiger", Wang Shuo is not very afraid.

Seeing that his skills were interrupted, Xu Wen became angry.

An angry roar came from his skull's mouth.

"Knowing everything clearly."

Just when Wang Shuo thought he could breathe a sigh of relief, Xu Wen found a gap and activated another skill.

Wang Shuo clearly felt that Xu Wen could predict all his own attacks.

Be sure to anticipate the enemy's opportunities and avoid them in advance.

"Damn, these bosses with skills are just so difficult to deal with!"

Wang Shuo let out a long sigh.

It seems that the trick of "I predicted that you predicted my prediction" should be used.

After fighting for a while, Wang Shuo found that he couldn't keep up with Xu Wen's dodge speed.

Obviously the opponent's basic attributes are much higher than his own.

Wang Shuo was a little anxious. The opponent's skill CD was very likely to be refreshed again.

It had to be interrupted again. This tense battle was very painful for Wang Shuo and others.

Sure enough, Xu Wen wanted to launch "righteousness and awe-inspiring" again.

Wang Shuo didn't have time to remind him this time. Fortunately, Gu Liji was alert and interrupted Xu Wen.

Wang Shuo thought for a while, then directly took advantage of his large number and surrounded all the soldiers.

All used long-range spears to directly attack.

Everyone just needs to poke in the middle.

The opponent is hard to beat with two fists and four hands, and he is also a civil servant. He must not be able to deal with this situation!

The fact was just as Wang Shuo expected, no matter how fast the opponent was, he still couldn't defend himself against a 360-degree attack with no blind spots.

"-12"

"-15"

"-147"

…

Although the damage to ordinary soldiers is not high, the overall damage caused by this continuous blood loss is still considerable.

You only need to interrupt him when he is about to release his skills.

Wang Shuo finally found a way to deal with him, which is called "too many ants bite the elephant to death".

There is no way, this Xu Wen is a level 40 silver boss after all.
